R7.title: R7 — Reliable hose placement

open_questions: Demonstrate targeting, cap/cover handling, capture tolerance, fill-stop, contamination resistance and safe disengagement; measure time and reliability.

R9.title: R9 — Remote conditions
R9.summary: Slope, wet-strength, soil infiltration and temperature can change reservoir performance. Flight limits and geozones also constrain service windows; remote water and energy resupply remain essential.
